title: Creamy Malaysian Pasta
description: A creamy and flavorful pasta dish with Malaysian-inspired flavors. Quick and easy to make!

ingredients.name: creamy
ingredients.notes: sour cream or heavy cream works well

ingredients.name: malaysian
ingredients.notes: curry powder or Malaysian curry paste

ingredients.name: fried
ingredients.notes: fried shallots or crispy fried onions

instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large pan, heat 1 tbsp of oil over medium heat.
Add granulated sugar, Malaysian curry powder, and stir for 1 minute.
Add creamy sauce and stir until smooth.
Add cooked pasta to the pan and toss with the sauce.
Top with fried shallots and serve hot.
